description_zh: 创建一个云盘异步复制关系
kebab_example: aliyun ebs create-disk-replica-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-zone-id cn-beijing-f --disk-id d-iq80sgp4d0xbk24q0000 --destination-region-id cn-shanghai --destination-disk-id d-sa1f82p58p1tdw9g0000 --destination-zone-id cn-shanghai-e --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDiskReplicaPair

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the replication pair
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the source disk (primary disk)
parameters.help_zh: 源云盘（主盘）所属的可用区ID
parameters.name: source_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source disk (primary disk)
parameters.name: disk_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the destination disk (secondary disk). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html operation to query the regions that support asynchronous replication
parameters.help_zh: 目标云盘（从盘）所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息
parameters.name: destination_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination disk (secondary disk)
parameters.name: destination_disk_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the destination disk (secondary disk)
parameters.help_zh: 目标云盘（从盘）所属的可用区ID
parameters.name: destination_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the replication pair. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系的名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: pair_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the replication pair. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the replication pair. Valid values:

PREPAY: subscription.

POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go.

Default value: POSTPAY
parameters.help_zh:
异步复制关系的付费方式。取值范围：
PREPAY：包年包月。
POSTPAY：按量付费。

默认值：POSTPAY
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration of the replication pair. This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to PREPAY. The unit of the duration is specified by `PeriodUnit`. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, and 60
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制关系的购买时长。当`ChargeType=PREPAY`时，该参数为必选参数。时长单位由`PeriodUnit`指定，取值范围：1、2、3、6、12、24、36、60
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration. Valid value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
异步复制关系购买时长的单位。当前仅支持Month。
Month：月
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth for asynchronous data replication between disks. The unit is Kbps. Valid values:

10240

20480

51200

102400

Default value: 10240.
When ChargeType is set to POSTPAY, you cannot specify this parameter. The system uses a value of 0, which means that the bandwidth is dynamically allocated based on data writes
parameters.help_zh:
云盘之间异步复制数据时的带宽。单位为Kbps。取值范围：

10240
20480
51200
102400

默认值：10240。
当ChargeType取值为POSTPAY时，不能指定本参数值，系统取值为0，表示云盘异步复制时根据数据写入变化动态分配
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair. The unit is seconds. Currently, only 900 is supported
parameters.help_zh: 云盘异步复制关系设定的RPO值，单位：秒。当前仅支持900秒
parameters.name: rpo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the replication pair belongs
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制对所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

false: Disables RTC.

true: Enables RTC.

Default value: false.

If the replication pair is added to a replication group, the setting of this parameter is the same as that of the replication group
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启复制时间控制（RTC）。取值范围：

false：关闭。
true：开启。

默认值：false。

若复制对加入复制组，则与复制组的属性保持一致
parameters.name: enable_rtc

ReplicaPairId.description_en: The ID of the replication pair
